response.text:
I can do that, but I need a couple things and your explicit confirmation before changing sharing (making it accessible to anyone with the link is a visible, non-reversible privacy change).

Please confirm and provide:
1. Where the signup sheet is stored (Google Drive/Google Sheets, OneDrive/SharePoint, Dropbox, Box, etc.).  
2. The file name or current sharing link (or paste the file URL).  
3. The exact permission you want for “anyone with the link” — Viewer (can only view), Commenter (if available), or Editor (can change the sheet).  
4. How you want me to send the link: paste it here in chat, or email it to (specify the address)?  
5. Confirm you understand “anyone with the link” means anyone who obtains the link can access the names and work emails in the sheet.

If you prefer to do it yourself, tell me which platform and I’ll give short step-by-step instructions. If you want me to proceed, reply “Proceed” and provide the file URL + answers to items 1–4.
